_comment: Rehab cost reference data for the Rochester/Dover/Somersworth/Exeter NH Seacoast corridor. Rates are $/unit, split into parts and labor. Each line item's 'source' field documents where its all-in installed-cost figure came from. Hand-tune any rate as real contractor quotes come in.
_methodology: All-in figures sourced from 2026 remodeling-cost research (national unless noted NH-specific), adjusted +10% for NH Seacoast where using national data -- derived from comparing NH Seacoast bathroom-remodel totals (~10-15% above national) and NH's explicitly-stated +15% electrical-panel-upgrade premium over national. Parts/labor split is a documented allocation, not independently sourced per item: labor-dominant trades (demo, plumbing, electrical, tile-setting) allocated ~65-80% labor; fixture/material-dominant items (cabinets, countertops, appliances, premium fixtures) allocated 60-70% parts.

line_items.name: Demo & prep
line_items.source: Nat'l demo labor $500-1,500/project (This Old House 2026), NH +10%, ~80% labor

line_items.name: Plumbing rough-in
line_items.source: Nat'l plumbing labor $1,000-4,000/project (This Old House 2026), NH +10%, ~35% parts

line_items.name: Electrical (GFCI, fan wiring)
line_items.source: Nat'l electrical labor $500-2,000/project (This Old House 2026), NH +10%, ~35% parts

line_items.name: Tile - floor
line_items.source: Nat'l tile labor $1,000-3,000/project + material $2-15/sqft (This Old House 2026), NH +10%

line_items.name: Tile - tub/shower surround
line_items.source: Same basis as floor tile, wet-wall labor premium for waterproofing, NH +10%

line_items.name: Toilet
line_items.source: Installed $200-800 budget-mid, $800+ luxury (Angi 2026), NH +10%

line_items.name: Vanity + sink
line_items.source: Installed $400-5,000, standard avg ~$1,600, custom ~$4,000+ (Angi/DIY Depot 2026), NH +10%

line_items.name: Tub/shower unit
line_items.source: Bathtub $1,100-5,900, shower $600 prefab to $10,000+ custom (HomeLight/Angi 2026), NH +10%

line_items.name: Paint/drywall
line_items.source: Nat'l finish-carpentry labor $500-1,500/project allocated to paint/drywall scope, NH +10%

line_items.name: Demo & prep
line_items.source: Scaled up from bathroom demo (more built-ins to remove), NH +10%

line_items.name: Cabinets
line_items.source: Stock $100-300/linear ft, custom $500-1,200+/linear ft, luxury $1,500+/linear ft (HomeAdvisor/NextDayCabinets 2026), NH +10%. Priced per linear foot of cabinet run, not room sqft -- run length drives cost.

line_items.name: Countertops
line_items.source: Laminate $25-40/sqft, quartz/granite $50-175/sqft, nat'l avg $75-95/sqft (SlabWise/Homewyse 2026), NH +10%

line_items.name: Appliance package
line_items.source: Standard package (fridge/microwave/range/dishwasher) $2,100-5,400; luxury $45,000-90,000+ (Yale Appliance/HomeGuide 2026), NH +10%. Flat per-kitchen line, not sqft-scaled -- dominates the luxury-tier total, flag prominently in output.

line_items.name: Kitchen plumbing (sink, dishwasher, disposal)
line_items.source: Derived from bathroom plumbing-per-fixture basis, NH +10%

line_items.name: Kitchen electrical (circuits, under-cabinet lighting)
line_items.source: Derived from bathroom electrical basis, scaled for kitchen's higher circuit-count code requirements, NH +10%

line_items.name: Flooring
line_items.source: LVP/laminate $2-5/sqft materials, hardwood/tile $6-12/sqft materials (general market pricing), NH +10%

line_items.name: Backsplash
line_items.source: Subway-tile economy to natural-stone/glass luxury, same basis as bathroom tile, NH +10%

line_items.name: Tear-off, underlayment, shingle, flashing
line_items.source: $5.50-8.50/sqft installed, NH-specific -- already localized for snow-load/ice-dam installation requirements (RoofVista/Compass Exteriors 2026), no further regional adjustment applied. Single tier: asphalt shingle is standard for rental properties; a metal/slate luxury tier was considered and rejected as not useful for rental-investment decisions.

line_items.name: Panel upgrade (200A)
line_items.source: $1,725-5,175 in NH, explicitly +15% above national average (CostOnce/TMB Electric Corp 2026), NH-specific, no further adjustment applied

line_items.name: General rewire
line_items.source: $6-10/sqft nationally (This Old House 2026); NH electrical panel data confirms NH runs above national, and this range's midpoint already sits within that premium -- no further multiplier applied to avoid compounding two separate regional adjustments

line_items.name: Knob-and-tube removal
line_items.source: $10,000-30,000 additional for pre-1960 knob-and-tube homes nationally (CostOnce/TMB Electric Corp 2026), backed out to $/sqft for a typical 1,800-2,500 sqft multi-family building. Additive on top of General rewire, not a replacement for it.
